items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I joined Lionel Hampton in San Francisco at the Golden --

ctx.x: This was in 1940 -- he went to California on vacation, and Mae went, his sister. Mae and Russell came back but Illinois stayed out there. That's when Lionel Hampton picked him up, and formed his band.
But Russell was in Milt Larkin's band for awhile, wasn't he?

items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Ham's musical director was Paul Moen... Pepper Trevor Martin on baritone and yours truly the other one more time on (inaudible) tenor and that was it.

ctx.x: I guess so, but Snooky was a good man. He was a good trumpet player. Had good chops, good round tone and a terrific musician.
